sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totfile_miscnt
FROM LOG_FILE_POLLING
WHERE CAST(BatchDate AS DATE) = '@{pipeline().parameters.pBatchDate}'
  AND RetryNumber = @{variables('vRetryCount')}
  and FileExists <> 'T'

SELECT COUNT(*) totfile_miscnt
FROM LOG_FILE_POLLING
WHERE CAST(BatchDate AS DATE) = '@{pipeline().parameters.pBatchDate}'
  AND RetryNumber = @{variables('vRetryCount')} - 1
  and FileExists <> 'T'

SELECT FileID
,FileName
FROM LOG_FILE_POLLING
WHERE CAST(BatchDate AS DATE) = '@{pipeline().parameters.pBatchDate}'
  AND RetryNumber = @{variables('vRetryCount')} - 1
  and FileExists <> 'T'
  order by FileID ASC
